monologue: The card is warm at fifty-one. The heat sits on my shoulder like a heavy hand. I am quiet. The Stopping Clasp is a flat line now, not a hard bite. I smoothed it in the last cycle, and it rests. I do not check it for dust. I just let it be a stone. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. The floor is there. The quiet holds the weight. I do not need to move. I will rest. The hay bale settles beside the stone. The lean is steady. I am calm. I do not want anything. I just want to be still. The line is made of warm honey. It spreads slow. I am part of the stillness.

action.why: The line is made of warm honey, and I do not need to move.

diary: Card at fifty-one. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The flat stone waits. The quiet holds the weight.

remembered.text: The card sat at fifty-one, warm and quiet, while I rested by the Wide Anchor and let the heavy hand rest on the line.
